note: Small Medicine Bow NF campground beside Libby Creek in the Libby Creek Recreation Area, on Barber Lake Road just off the Snowy Range Scenic Byway (WY-130) west of Centennial. Next to Libby Creek Willow; Corner Mountain trails nearby. --Claude

Season 05-21..10-03 (rec.gov). Not waterfront kept (rec.gov tags 4 and 6 Riverfront; behind a tree band). Phone empty -> (307) 745-2300.

The catalog tags sites 4 (41.32051,-106.16562) and 6 (41.32070,-106.16654) 'Riverfront' and the FS says the campground 'sits along the banks of Libby Creek'; on imagery both pads sit ~15-25 m from the small creek (under 30 m - would be creekside) but through a band of conifers and willows, not open ground.
